title: Design: Picking one customer in the chip shows 1 selected and narrows the list
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have a new asset for this test with work orders for customer B and customer C.
  • Start on the asset's Work Orders tab.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p7-04-after-one-customer-picked.png, bt-p7-05-after-applied.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Customer chip.
  2. Tick customer B.
  3. Click outside the panel.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The panel opens.

Step 2:

  • "All customers" is unticked with "1 selected" at its right; customer B is ticked.
  • The chip turns light blue with blue text "Customer: [customer B's name]" cut with "..." when long.

Step 3:

  • The panel closes; only customer B's work orders are listed and the chip stays light blue.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
